-- The positions on no screen go on Unloader A when this is saved. [Put them on Screen A]

## …Put them on Unloader A, then Save (Unloader A's write takes POS_B1-POS_B4)
  1  GET /api/operator-stations/12/claimed-nodes
  2  PUT /api/operator-stations/12/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "ULD_1",
           "POS_B1",
           "POS_B2",
           "POS_B3",
           "POS_B4"
         ]
       }
  3  PUT /api/processes/1/positions
       {
         "nodes": []
       }
  4  GET /api/process-nodes
  5  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  6  GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1
-- notice: success "Saved"
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Positions and routing › Loader windows › Make a screen on Press A (LDR_1)
  1  POST /api/loader-boards
       {
         "loader_key": "LDR_1",
         "process_id": 1
       }
  2  GET /api/operator-stations
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes
  5  GET /api/operator-stations/32/claimed-nodes
-- sheet closed
